prompts.prompt: Candid lifestyle photo of an Indonesian woman in her late 20s, wearing a casual olive t-shirt, sitting by a sunlit window at home, looking at her smartphone with a warm confident smile, natural soft morning light, shallow depth of field, shot on 50mm lens, realistic skin texture, warm teal-and-neutral color grading, portrait orientation, editorial lifestyle photography style
prompts.negativePrompt: posed stock photo, gym setting, fitness model, extreme makeup, text overlay, logo, watermark, illustration, 3D render, plastic skin
prompts.notes: Foto paling penting (hero) — jadi first impression dari iklan. Cek hasil generate beberapa kali, pilih yang paling natural, hindari yang terlihat 'AI banget'.

prompts.prompt: Overhead 45-degree shot of a modest Indonesian home dining table: steamed white rice, grilled chicken (ayam bakar), a small bowl of sambal, sliced cucumber and tomato, simple woven placemat, warm natural window light, soft shadows, authentic home-cooked styling (not restaurant plating), landscape orientation
prompts.negativePrompt: restaurant plating, fine dining, hands, people, text, logo, illustration
prompts.notes: Fokus makanan saja, tanpa wajah/tangan — relatability lewat objek familiar, bukan akting ekspresi.
